usage: 橙色 (caang2 sik1) is used as a noun to refer to the color orange.
You can use 橙色 to describe the color of clothes, objects, or even fruits.
When combining 橙色 with a noun, it often acts as an adjective in spoken Cantonese, like 橙色衫 (orange shirt).
You can also use 橙色 in questions or sentences about preferences, like 喜唔喜歡橙色? (Do you like orange?).
In Hong Kong Cantonese, 橙色 is the standard term for orange color instead of using English words.
